name: rkflashtool
why: Flashes Rockchip boards over USB, a window into how embedded firmware gets written to physical devices.

brief.what_it_is: A command-line toolset written in C for flashing Rockchip system-on-chip devices. The SourceForge listing and the project wiki both describe it as tools for flashing Rockchip devices, and the wiki names the supported chips: RK2808, RK2818, RK2918, RK3066, RK3068 and RK3188. Homebrew installs eight executables: rkcrc, rkflashtool, rkmisc, rkpad, rkparameters, rkparametersblock, rkunpack and rkunsign. I did not read usage docs for any of them, so their inputs and outputs are not confirmed. The scout note says it flashes boards over USB, but I did not see that stated on the pages I read.
brief.why_it_exists: The pages I read give no problem statement beyond the one-line purpose of flashing Rockchip devices.
brief.install_notes: No install steps were found on the pages I read. The SourceForge listing shows platforms BSD, Cygwin, Linux, Mac and MinGW/MSYS2, and the wiki shows no setup steps. Homebrew's caveats field is empty.
brief.standout: The tool targets a specific older generation of Rockchip chips, listed by model number on the wiki, and is a set of small single-purpose executables rather than one program. Neither point was compared against similar tools, so treat this as a description, not a comparison.
brief.status: Quiet. The SourceForge page shows Last Update 2018-02-11, one user review from 2012, and about 20 downloads in the past week. The wiki's most recent comment is from 2017 and mentions a fix shipped in version 6.1. No release or commit data was visible, and I could not find the project's current code host.
brief.caveats: I could not read a README. The SourceForge homepage was mostly page chrome, and my guessed GitHub URL returned 404. Device coverage is limited to the older chips listed on the wiki. The license is BSD according to SourceForge. Nothing I read warns about hazards, but flashing firmware onto a device can brick it, which the pages do not discuss.
quotes: Tool for flashing Rockchip RK2808, RK2818, RK2918, RK3066, RK3068 and RK3188 devices.
